items.subject: Make ONE holographic worn die-cut sticker combining the authentic FAMILYSYNC wordmark from the top of Image 1 with the real J.P.Morgan PAYMENTS sponsor mark from the lower portion. The blue background strip in Image 1 is only slide background: remove it and use cream behind the logo marks. No invented icons, faces, bank seals, sponsor claims or new text.
